title: Consume TextFrameProperties: insets, vertical align, auto-size in the type engine
outcome: Text frames honor their validated textFrame contract: insets shrink the measure, verticalAlign positions the composed block, autoSize grows the frame to fit content, and single-column zero-inset frames render pixel-identically to today.
before: Gap audit 2026-08-27 (main 14e2812): every type frame carries textFrame (types.ts:172-181, defaults text-model.ts:23-32), migration stamps it (migrate.ts:157-160), validation enforces it (factory.ts:1090-1104) - and drawTypeFrame composes with raw layer w/h (type.ts:482): insets, verticalAlign, autoSize, columns/columnGutter and kind point/path are validated but consumed nowhere (pathLayerId validated at factory.ts:1101-1103, used nowhere). Defaults (inset 0, 1 column) mean implementing this moves no existing pixels.
after: Insets/verticalAlign/autoSize visibly and truthfully affect rendering; autoSize feedback flows through a reversible bus command; the zero-inset default path is pixel-identical.
acceptance: A frame with inset 24 composes against the reduced measure with the first baseline shifted; screenshot evidence.
verticalAlign center centers the composed block between frame top/bottom.
autoSize height grows the frame via a new reversible bus command to fit composeFrame height; undo restores.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted tests, npm run test:unit baseline, npm run build pass.
evidence: Screenshot evidence for insets and vertical alignment

critic.notes: User-visible layout behavior; critic judges professional semantics.

delta.before: textFrame is validated metadata with zero rendering effect.
delta.after: Insets/verticalAlign/autoSize are real, reversible, and regression-safe.
delta.new_debt: Multi-column flow and path-kind frames remain future work.
